caption: Palazzo dei Papi, Viterbo
composition: Medieval papal palace with Loggia delle Benedizioni pointed arches · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera stands on the piazza before the Palazzo dei Papi in the clear light of the 11:03 morning. The Loggia delle Benedizioni dominates the frame with its row of pointed arches on slender columns, the crenellated tower wall rising behind at the right, while the simpler palace wing stretches away at the left. The warm grey stonework glows in the sun beneath a pale blue sky, and the empty cobbled forecourt emphasizes the building's medieval gravity.
